title: Chicken Galette with Herb Crust
description: A French-inspired dish featuring a flaky pastry crust infused with herbs and topped with tender chicken.
instructions: Roll out the herbal galette dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the chicken breast in the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Sprinkle the thyme, salt, and pepper over the chicken.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the chicken, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the edges of the dough with kissed butter.
Transfer the galette to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
Let the galette rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
